note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2869 Section 5.1 ("This attribute indicates how many times the Acct-Input-Octets counter has wrapped around 2^32 over the course of this service being provided, and can only be present in Accounting-Request records where the Acct-Status-Type is set to Stop or Interim-Update."). In 38267f5e0c, both tagged units migrated from the deleted interface-name stub to the original-PPP-unit capture fixture (bindAcctUnit). TestBuildAcctPacketGigawords supplies a terminal measurement of 2*2^32+100 rx and 3*2^32+200 tx over zero baseline (with live counters at 0), calls captureEnd/captureTerminal, and asserts exact Acct-Input-Octets 100 and Acct-Input-Gigawords 2 (plus output and packets) on a Stop built by buildAcctPacket/splitGigawords. TestRFC2869GigawordsAbsentOnStart binds a live capture carrying 2*2^32+100 rx and 3*2^32+200 tx over zero baseline and asserts neither Gigawords attribute appears on Start; verified in acct.go that recordCounters takes liveDelta on non-Stop so breaking the Stop/Interim guard in buildAcctPacket would emit both Gigawords. Verdict enforced stands.
